request.description:
Initiate a transfer between two accounts. Triggers the TransferSaga via Kafka.

Request: InitiateTransactionRequest {
  idempotencyKey: String (8-64 chars, required) — prevents duplicate submissions,
  sourceAccountId: UUID (required),
  targetAccountId: UUID (optional if targetAccountNumber provided),
  targetAccountNumber: String (optional),
  targetUserId: UUID (optional),
  amount: BigDecimal (0.01 to 99999999.9999, required),
  currency: String (e.g. MXN),
  transactionType: TRANSFER | PAYMENT | DEPOSIT | WITHDRAWAL,
  channel: APP | WEB | API | ATM,
  description: String (max 500 chars),
  merchantName: String (max 200),
  merchantCategoryCode: String (max 4, e.g. 5411),
  referenceNumber: String (max 100)
}

Response 202 Accepted: TransactionResponse {
  transactionId: String (UUID),
  status: String (INITIATED),
  amount: BigDecimal,
  currency: String,
  transactionType: String,
  description: String,
  initiatedAt: String (ISO-8601),
  completedAt: String (null while in-flight),
  failureReason: String (null)
}
